title: Replace incorrect and untested EMA cases in CCP beacon vectors
description: test/vectors/ccp_beacon_format.json claims EMA(0,[8,12,10,11],alpha=1/4)=5.859375/384000 Q16, but the exact result is 7.15625/468992 Q16. The negative case contains no oracle at all, and python/tests/timing/test_ccp_beacon_format.py collects EMA cases but never parameterizes a test, so both errors pass silently. Replace divergence prose with language-neutral Q16.16 arithmetic-shift outputs for positive/negative samples and add an independent literal recurrence test against production EMA behavior.
